metaDescription: Own mineral rights near Stockdale in Washington County? We buy Marcellus interests directly from families with honest cash offers.
heroLead: Stockdale is one of the small Mon Valley boroughs that most outsiders drive past without a second look, but the families who've stayed here know exactly how much their mineral rights have changed in value over the last twenty years.
intro: Stockdale sits along the Monongahela River in Washington County, a small borough driven by the coal and coke industry that once ran through this valley. Mineral ownership here often traces through old company transactions layered on top of family land, and Washington County's position at the center of the wet-gas Marcellus play means even modest tracts around Stockdale have seen real development interest over the years.

For families who've held onto land here through several generations, the challenge usually isn't finding out whether a well exists nearby, it's confirming exactly what rights survived the various coal and coke era transactions their ancestors were part of.

sections.heading: Coal-Era Deeds Along the Mon Valley
paragraphs: A lot of Stockdale-area mineral interests trace back to coal company transactions from the late 1800s and early 1900s, when coal, oil, and gas rights were sometimes severed separately and sold to different buyers. We trace that specific chain of title before ever discussing value, so we're working from an accurate picture of what you actually hold.

sections.heading: Getting to a Real Cash Offer
paragraphs: Once ownership is confirmed, we check your parcel against current DEP permits and unit filings, review any lease or statement paperwork you have, and put together a straightforward offer with the reasoning laid out clearly.

faqs.question: My deed references an old coal company from the 1800s. Do I still own the gas rights?
faqs.answer: It depends on the exact severance language in that original deed. We research the recorded history to confirm what remains with your interest today.

faqs.question: Is Stockdale inside an active gas unit?
faqs.answer: We check current DEP unit and permit records against your specific parcel rather than making a general assumption about the whole borough.

faqs.question: How do you determine a fair price for an older, layered interest like this?
faqs.answer: We base our offer on confirmed ownership, current or likely unit participation, and production data where it exists, and we explain every part of that calculation before you decide anything.

faqs.question: What if my family's tract was part of a larger farm that got split up decades ago?
faqs.answer: That's common along the Mon Valley. We research the recorder of deeds history to confirm exactly which portion, and what fractional share, belongs to your branch of the family.
